name: Ship of Harkinian [anylinux]
description:
Ship of Harkinian is an enhanced native PC port of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time. Compiled natively from the decompilation of the N64 ROM, it offers extensive modern visual and gameplay enhancements.

Features:
- Smooth 60+ FPS gameplay with high-resolution and ultrawide display rendering
- Free camera control with right analog stick and mouse-look options
- Extensive quality-of-life enhancements including D-pad item equip and faster text
- Integrated randomizer modes and custom modding support
- Requires an authentic Ocarina of Time ROM for asset extraction

This is an unofficial AnyLinux AppImage, which is able to work anywhere including glibc and musl. For more info: https://pkgforge-dev.github.io/Anylinux-AppImages/
